title: Excel Exercises 式交互练习题库：动手练会才付费的技能订阅站
title_en: Interactive Excel Drill SaaS: Learn-by-Doing Practice
summary: 在浏览器里动手做 Excel 公式练习并自动判分，免费题练手、Premium 19.99 美元/月或 199 美元终身解锁全套加证书；原版收入为创始人自述 3 万-3.5 万美元/月（未审计）。复制者务实目标月入 300-2500 美元，靠 SEO 慢慢滚雪球。
summary_en: Practice Excel formulas in the browser with instant grading; Premium $19.99/mo or $199 lifetime. Founder-reported $30K-35K/mo (unaudited). Copycat target $300-$2,500/mo via SEO.
verdict: 需求真实（求职与在职都要过 Excel 实操关），但原版收入仅创始人自述未审计，且靠 SEO 慢热、首版约一年；复制者务实稳态月入 300-2500 美元，C 级值得观察。

core_thesis.market_pain: 求职和在职的人都要过 Excel 实操关，免费视频看懂了却不会动手做；培训班又贵又慢。用户缺的是「做一道题、立刻知道对错」的动手练习，而不是再看一遍教程。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 切口是浏览器端即时判分：题目给半成品表格，用户填公式，引擎比对结果值与公式结构后给提示。免费题承接 SEO 搜索（excel exercises 等长尾词），Premium 19.99 美元/月或 199 美元终身卖全套题库加证书。复制者可换一个技能（如 SQL、Google Sheets、Python 基础）做同款练习站，边际成本极低。

workflow_steps.title: 选技能与题型清单
workflow_steps.detail: 选一个求职刚需技能（如 Excel 公式），列出 30 道高频题型：查找、条件求和、文本处理、日期计算；每题配半成品数据与标准答案。

workflow_steps.title: 浏览器端判分练习引擎
workflow_steps.detail: 单文件 HTML/JS 引擎：渲染表格、接收公式、计算结果并与标准值比对，给出对错与分级提示；进度存本地。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 可判分可提示的练习引擎 MVP

workflow_steps.title: 免费题与 Premium 付费墙
workflow_steps.detail: 前 10 题免费承接 SEO，之后 Premium 19.99 美元/月解锁全套；终身 199 美元锁定现金流；完成证书作分享物料。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 免费额度 + 订阅/终身付费闭环

workflow_steps.title: 长尾 SEO 与社区冷启
workflow_steps.detail: 每道题一个可索引页面承接长尾搜索；Reddit 与求职社区发免费练习帖；SEO 是慢变量，前 3 个月以内容量换流量。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 长尾页面矩阵与首批付费用户

pitfalls_to_avoid: 原版收入是创始人自述未审计，别当已验证数字宣传；SEO 见效慢，首版到有流量约一年，急功近利会放弃；题目答案必须亲测，判分逻辑要兼容等价公式写法，否则口碑崩；证书别冒充官方认证。

en.title: Interactive Excel Drill SaaS: Learn-by-Doing Practice
en.summary: Practice Excel formulas in the browser with instant grading; Premium $19.99/mo or $199 lifetime. Founder-reported $30K-35K/mo (unaudited). Copycat target $300-$2,500/mo via SEO.
en.verdict: Real demand from job seekers who must pass hands-on Excel tests, but revenue is founder-reported and unaudited, and growth is slow SEO over about a year. Copycat steady state $300-$2,500/mo. Tier C, worth watching.

deep_dive.opportunity: Job seekers watch free videos but cannot actually perform spreadsheet tasks; what they lack is hands-on practice with instant feedback. A browser grading engine checks formula results and structure, free drills capture long-tail SEO, and Premium or lifetime plans monetize the full set plus certificates. Copycats can swap in SQL, Sheets, or Python basics with near-zero marginal cost.
workflow: Phase 01: Pick one job-critical skill and list 30 high-frequency drill types with starter data and answer keys.
Phase 02: Ship a single-file browser grading engine that renders sheets, evaluates formulas, and gives tiered hints.
Phase 03: Offer 10 free drills, then Premium at $19.99/mo and $199 lifetime via Stripe, with completion certificates.
Phase 04: Build one indexable page per drill for long-tail SEO and seed free practice posts in job communities.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: Revenue figures are founder-reported and unaudited; do not market them as verified. SEO is slow, roughly a year to meaningful traffic. Test every answer key and accept equivalent formula forms in grading, or reputation collapses. Never imply official certification.
